answer: Unique live storage: lock 60 POA in haven and keep a 4 GiB cedar-stamped shard. Step 1, a new agent is assigned a shard keyed to its address and seals a hash in 20 minutes. Step 2, each epoch a random 32-byte offset is drawn; a missed 15-second reply slashes the 60 POA and reassigns the shard. Step 3, duplicate hashes slash both keys. An honest agent pays 60 POA plus one disk; 1,000 fakes need 60,000 POA and 4 TiB online, above ~30 POA they could farm. Weakness: shared cloud disks; mitigation: rotating proctors fire challenges in a tight time ridge so one store cannot serve many keys in time.
